heading: The Water Crystal
intro: You are a captain of the Red Fleet, and the Fleet has come to Ilmara for a crystal. The king wants it, and the king has never asked for anything twice. Whatever you think of the work, the sword at your hip is dark steel, and the seal on your chest is his.

objectives.instruction: Take the Water Crystal from its altar
Fly home and report to King Aldous in the throne room
Find your friend Captain Kessa in the barracks
Rest in your quarters, then leave for Hazevale with Kessa at dawn
